summary: Gravel bushland car park beside Sir Samuel Griffith Drive, many cars, no homes.
reasons: Open gravel car park, full of cars
Pin is in bush; car park 15 m off

drivers.seclusion: Forest to the west and south, a sports field to the north; no buildings or homes in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel surface meets the road edge, with many cars parked, so room and way in are clear.
drivers.traffic: Sir Samuel Griffith Drive runs beside it, with parked cars along the verge too.
drivers.convention: Mapped public car park (access yes, no fee) heavily used by walkers and riders.

flags: Pin sits in dense bush on a steep creek bank, 38% max grade; ring is off
Slope at the car park not measured, assumed about 3%
East Ithaca Creek 2 m from the pin
sun_shade: Tall trees shade the west and south; the gravel is partly open to the afternoon sun.

best_section.where: Gravel car park just east of the pin, on the west side of the road
